description: Source code for the 'antlr' package implementing a lexer with classes, interfaces, and methods for token recognition, error handling, and lexer state management.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: Interface defining methods for a lexer, including token emission and mode setting.

classes.name: BaseLexer
classes.description: Concrete implementation of a lexer with state management, token generation, and error recovery.

methods.name: NewBaseLexer
methods.description: Constructor function initializing a new BaseLexer instance with input stream and default settings.

methods.name: NextToken
methods.description: Retrieves the next token from the input stream, handling EOF, skipping, and mode switching.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Creates and emits a token based on current lexer state.

methods.name: EmitEOF
methods.description: Emits an EOF token indicating end of input.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets lexer state variables to initial conditions.

methods.name: SetInputStream
methods.description: Resets the input stream and associated lexer state.

methods.name: PushMode
methods.description: Saves current mode and switches to a new mode.

methods.name: PopMode
methods.description: Restores the previous lexer mode from the stack.
